visualCharacteristics: Two-column report feature: report cover image on one side; intro summary, a 'Table of Contents' heading + list, and Download (PDF) / Print CTAs on the other.
contentPattern: One columns row, two cells: cell 1 = cover image; cell 2 = intro paragraphs + TOC heading + TOC list + Download/Print links.
usage: Report/annual-report landing pages that pair a cover with a download and contents.
